post.caption: Princess Diana wore the Spencer tiara on her wedding day, July 29, 1981. It is a Spencer family heirloom, and her sisters Jane in 1978 and Sarah in 1980 wore it at their weddings first. Its center heart was a 1919 wedding present to Diana's grandmother, and Garrard remodeled it in the 1930s. Her father kept lending it to her, and in 2018 her niece Celia wore it at her own wedding.
